units.source_text: 杜子春提心吊胆，害怕的看向下面，但是，

en.t: Toshishun looked down in terror, his heart pounding, but

units.source_text: 夕阳余晖中，只能看见绵绵青山，

en.t: in the lingering glow of the sunset, all he could see was range after range of blue-green mountains,

units.source_text: 洛阳城的西城门早就消失的无影无踪了，

en.t: and the western gate of Luoyang had long since vanished without a trace,

units.source_text: 可能是早就被遮蔽在云层之中了吧。

en.t: perhaps it had already been hidden away inside the layers of cloud.

units.source_text: 铁冠子鬓边的白发随风飞扬，大声吟唱：

en.t: The white hair at Tieguanzi's temples streamed in the wind, and he chanted loudly:
